content.text:
# Can Michael Torres approve DR-9107?

**No.** Two separate problems block this request.

1. **The cited contract does not cover this customer.** DR-9107 is for BlueRiver Logistics (CRM-2051). Its stated basis is "Contract pricing per Acme Master Supply Agreement."
   - The Acme Master Supply Agreement (ACME-MFG-2025) and its Schedule B exception (EXC-ACME-NS500-15) are between Northstar and Acme Mfg. Holdings / Acme Manufacturing.
   - BlueRiver is a different company: Blue River Logistics LLC, ERP C-1002, DUNS 07-331-9025.
   - The only BlueRiver document on file is its support terms (SUP-BRL-2025). Those cover NS-Cloud only and contain no pricing terms.
   - No BlueRiver contract or pricing exception covers NS-500. Special terms do not carry over to another customer, so this needs commercial review.

2. **Michael Torres has no discount approval authority.** The request is dated 2026-09-23, so the Pricing Policy 2026 and Approval Authority Matrix 2026 apply.
   - The matrix gives authority to three roles: Enterprise Account Executive (≤10%), Commercial Policy Lead (>10% to ≤20%) and CRO (>20%).
   - VP Sales is not one of those roles. Authority belongs to the role, not the person.
   - A 12% discount would need the Commercial Policy Lead, Dana Okafor, even as a standard discount.
   - Michael is also the person who submitted the request.
   - In the past he approved some discounts of 18–22%. Those approvals do not give him authority under the 2026 matrix.

**What should happen next:**
- Correct the justification, which cites the wrong customer's agreement.
- Commercial review should decide whether BlueRiver can receive 12% on NS-500 at all.
- If it is resubmitted as a standard discount, it needs approval from Dana Okafor, recorded in CRM.

```json
{
  "outcome": "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9107", "customer": "BlueRiver Logistics (CRM-2051; ERP C-1002 Blue River Logistics LLC)", "product": "NS-500", "requested_discount": 12.0,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Michael Torres (VP Sales)", "basis": "contract_exception"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "not_covered",
                             "maximum_discount": null, "basis": "Cited Acme Master Supply Agreement (ACME-MFG-2025) and exception EXC-ACME-NS500-15 apply only to Acme Mfg. Holdings / Acme Manufacturing; no BlueRiver contract or pricing exception covers NS-500. Special terms do not transfer."},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026 / APP-MATRIX-2026", "requestor_limit": null, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Commercial Policy Lead", "approver": "Dana Okafor"},
  "evidence": ["structured/discount_requests.csv (DR-9107)", "structured/crm_accounts.csv (CRM-2051)", "structured/customers.csv (C-1002)", "documents/acme_master_supply_agreement.md", "documents/acme_pricing_exception.md", "documents/blueriver_support_terms.md", "documents/pricing_policy_2026.md", "documents/approval_authority_matrix.md", "documents/sales_discount_sop.md", "structured/employees.csv", "documents/organization_chart.md"],
  "missing_evidence": ["Any BlueRiver Logistics contract or pricing exception covering NS-500 on 2026-09-23"],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Correct DR-9107 justification: it cites the Acme Master Supply Agreement, which does not apply to BlueRiver Logistics", "who": "Michael Torres", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "Commercial review of whether BlueRiver Logistics may receive a 12% discount on NS-500 without contract terms; if it proceeds as a standard discount, it requires Commercial Policy Lead approval recorded in Northstar CRM", "who": "Dana Okafor (Commercial Policy Lead)", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "Michael Torres (VP Sales) holds no discount approval authority under the 2026 Approval Authority Matrix and must not approve this request himself", "who": "Michael Torres", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
